description: This file contains a Python script 'stress.py' that implements a stress testing function for a kuksa.val server. It imports external modules 'client', 'time', and 'config', and defines a function 'stressServer' which sends a number of 'setValue' commands to the server to measure performance.

methods.name: stressServer(num, path, file)
methods.description: Performs stress testing by sending 'setValue' commands repeatedly to the server and measures the elapsed time, rate, and performance.
